messages:
Mia (CS): Heads-up — Vela Inc opened a support ticket asking for EU-only allowlist + a temporary throttle increase while they finish migration. They said onboarding tests fail due to 403s from EU region and hitting 5rps ceiling. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4892
Oliver (Solutions): Ack. Do we have their IPs and legal signoff for EU region? Renewal is in 6 weeks; getting them stable this week reduces churn risk.
Mia (CS): They sent IP blocks in the ticket and confirmed DPA signed. IPs: 34.120.192.16/28 and 35.189.44.0/28. Request: allowlist those, enable eu-west-1 routing, bump throttle from 5 -> 12 rps for 7 days, then back to 6 rps.
Raj (Infra): I can add the CIDRs to the account-level allowlist but need the customer account id and confirm whether this is for Hosted or Dedicated. Also need a change window — low risk but will apply to routing tables.
Mia (CS): Account ID vell-02 (internal: acct_0249). Hosted API (not Dedicated). They want immediate so their UAT isn't blocked — pref on-call to do it now if safe.
Anna (Eng): Quick checklist: 1) add allowlist entries to customer ACL 2) add eu-west-1 to routing policy for acct_0249 3) update per-route throttle policy from 5 to 12 for 7d 4) add rollback job to set to 6 rps after 7d. I can run the rollout if Raj gives the greenlight.
Raj (Infra): I can apply now. Patching config service with small JSON, will route only by policy for acct_0249. Applying in ~2m.
Raj (Infra): patch payload:
```json
{"account":"acct_0249","allowlist":["34.120.192.16/28","35.189.44.0/28"],"regions":["eu-west-1"],"throttle_rps":12,"throttle_expiry":"2026-03-27T21:00:00Z","rollback_rps":6}
```
Oliver (Solutions): Thanks. Mia — can you confirm scheduling a 30-min enablement session for tomorrow to walk them through best practices (batching, prefix caching) so they don't need throttle continuations? That helps renewal.
Mia (CS): Scheduled 2026-03-24 10:00 CET, invite sent to Vela contacts and CS playbook link. Will capture feedback in the ticket and a short NPS after onboarding.
RedwoodBot: allowlist updated for acct_0249 by raj@infra, change-id ch_78291, applied to eu-west-1.
Anna (Eng): Monitoring hooks in place — I added a temporary alert to watch 95th percentile latency in eu-west-1 for acct_0249 and a token-cost spike alert. If errors >2% in 10m we rollback throttle to 6 rps early.
Mia (CS): Customer note from support thread: "Thanks — once we get EU routing they can proceed with load tests. Appreciate the quick turnaround." :thumbsup:
Oliver (Solutions): Good. Capture in renewal tracker: risk reduced from "at-risk" -> "watch". Mia, drop summary into CS-renewals doc and mark follow-up after enablement.
Mia (CS): Will do. Adding short post-action item list to the ticket: 1) confirm allowlist connectivity 2) observe for 24h 3) run enablement session tomorrow 4) collect qualitative feedback and NPS 5) auto-rollback verification.
RedwoodBot: change-id ch_78291 scheduled rollback job created to set throttle_rps=6 at 2026-03-27T21:00:10Z.
Raj (Infra): All good from infra side. Leaving watch on logs for any unexpected 403s.
Anna (Eng): If they need a longer window, we'll scope a short contract amendment. For now, everything looks safe.
Mia (CS): Closing thread here; will post post-mortem if anything pops. Thanks team :heart:
